plugins.name: Service Map
plugins.description: Visual graph of services from parent-child span references. Node size = span volume, edge weight = call count, red ring = errors. Click a node to drill into its service.
plugins.author: edgeless-dev

plugins.name: Example Plug-in
plugins.description: Hello-world panel demonstrating the Edgeless OTel Command plug-in API. Fork this to build your own.
plugins.author: edgeless-dev

plugins.name: Static Field
plugins.description: Dense pixel-grid where each cell is one span. Hue = service, brightness = duration, red = error. Click a pixel to drill into its trace. Pairs with the Outrun theme.
plugins.author: edgeless-dev
